'''Romba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] scout of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. To defend his village from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] invasion, Romba prepared traps and was one of the first Ewoks to engage the Empire's forces in [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]]. Romba and the other Ewoks' efforts not only saved Bright Tree Village but also helped the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] turn the tide of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:Romba.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Romba wielding a spear]]
According to [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] myth, the name "[[Romba (legend)|Romba]]" belonged to a hunter who fooled a [[Gorax/Legends|gorax]] into eating its own feet.<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Likewise, this Ewok who bore his name was a dedicated scout. When fellow scout [[Wuta]] spotted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] invaders on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], he would look for fallen trees that could be used to make weapons to combat the offworlders. He contacted Romba, who oversaw the construction of log traps to use against Imperial [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|walkers]]. But it was another kind of trap&mdash;this one for [[Boar-wolf/Legends|boarwolves]]&mdash;that captured three [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members and their two droids.<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|90|EWO 9-10|Ewoks}}</ref> When Romba and the other Ewoks in his hunting party approached the Rebels with their spears readied, they suddenly saw that one of them was [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and they began to worship the gilded [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. Romba spoke with [[Rabin (Ewok)|Rabin]] about the droid reverently,<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" /> likely because of their experience with the droid some time ago at the failed [[Chirpa–Gorneesh peace summit|Chirpa-Gorneesh peace summit]].<ref name="Ewoks 10: The Demons of Endor">[[Ewoks (1985) 10|''Ewoks'' (1985) 10]]</ref> After the Ewoks took the droid and the Rebels back to [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], C-3PO and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] convinced the tribe to help the Alliance fight their mutual enemy, the Empire.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" /><ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi (novel)">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' (novel)]]</ref>

[[File:Corpsey.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Romba weeps for Nanta, his fatally wounded brother-in-arms.]]
The following day, Romba was among the first group of Ewoks to engage in a surprise attack against the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Later in the battle, he and other Ewoks strangled stormtroopers with the use of [[Bola/Legends|bolas]]. Romba then proceeded to aid in the launching of [[Catapult/Legends|catapults]] against the Empire's AT-STs. When the walkers returned fire, Romba and the others fled. As he and [[Nanta/Legends|Nanta]] ran, a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] blast hit and incapacitated the two. Romba quickly recovered, but when he reached for his friend to get up and continue running, Nanta did not move. Kneeling over his body, Romba spared a moment to mourn his fallen comrade.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

As the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]] raged on, the tide began to turn when the Rebel [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and two Ewoks, [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]] and [[Wunka/Legends|Wunka]], commandeered an AT-ST and used it against the Imperials. Romba—now attacking with [[Bow/Legends|bow]] and [[Arrow/Legends|arrow]]—and his fellow warriors stopped and cheered on the battlefield when they witnessed the walker fighting for their side.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

After the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] was destroyed and the battle ended in the Alliance's favor, the Ewoks and Rebels held a joyous celebration at Bright Tree Village.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

==Personality and traits==
Like the hunter whose name he bore, Romba was a dedicated Ewok scout. He was knowledgeable in the art of setting traps, overseeing the construction of log traps to fight the Imperial invaders.<ref name="Fact File" /> Romba was also capable of using many of the Ewoks' weapons&mdash;such as the bolas and the bow and arrow&mdash;being among the very first group of Ewoks to engage in a surprise attack against the Imperial stormtroopers. Romba mourned his comrade, when he was killed by a laser blast.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rombas.jpg|thumb|left|250px|thumb|Romba (left) and another Ewok (right)]]
There are two different Ewoks with similar facial features who have been identified as Romba. The first is a brown-hooded Ewok who was made into an action figure by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]], one of "the last seventeen."<ref name="Rebelscum">{{Rebelscum|url=vintromba.asp|text=Rebelscum.com: Vintage Star Wars Photo Archives}}</ref> This particularly short Ewok, who has a brown hood that ties together at the neck, appears in a scene where he mourns for [[Nanta/Legends|Nanta]], who was killed. Romba was played by [[Debbie Lee Carrington]].<ref name="CIVOPAGL">{{WebCite|url=http://officialpix.com/OPX/Celebrities.html|text=Celebration IV Official Pix Autograph Guest List|archivedate=20071015144459}}</ref><ref name="TFN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/jedicouncil/interview/carrington.asp|text=TheForce.Net interview with Debbie Lee Carrington|archivedate=20041212113818}}</ref> However, a [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|Customizable Card Game]] card produced years later identified another unnamed Ewok, this one taller and with a pinkish hood, as Romba,<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Romba}}</ref> while the original Romba was featured anonymously on another card.<ref name="CCG2">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Ewok Spearman}}</ref> This misattribution was repeated in ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 90]]''. But in 2007, [[Leland Chee]] corrected the situation by identifying Carrington's Ewok as Romba in time for her appearance at [[Celebration IV]].<ref name="SWBlog">{{Blog|teekay-421|48/comments|Ewok Roster}}</ref> The same year, a new action figure of Romba was produced by [[Hasbro]], again with the proper likeness.<ref name="Rebelscum2">{{Rebelscum|url=TAC43ewoks.asp|text=Rebelscum.com: Star Wars The 30th Anniversary Collection Photo Archives}}</ref>

The character coin packaged with Kenner's [[W:c:swmerchandise:Romba (93730)|1985 Romba action figure]] claims Romba is a warrior.

Although some claim that Rabin and Romba's short dialogue exchange sounded like "That guy's wise" and "More than I am short," [[Pablo Hidalgo]] assures that this is not the case, but rather fans "picking up unintended patterns."<ref name="Star Wars Insider 70">{{InsiderCite|70|Ask Lobot|Star Wars Q&A}}</ref>

The Ewok suit Debbie Carrington wore for Romba in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] is apparently the same suit she later wore as [[Weechee Warrick]] in ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''.<ref name="SWBlog" />

[[File:MikeCottrell.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mike Cottrell as Romba]]
An image from ''[[The Making of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]'' seems to indicate that [[Mike Cottrell]] also played Romba at some point.
